description: This Java class is a REST controller for managing desktop sessions, providing endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting desktop session entities.

classes.name: DesktopSessionController
classes.description: REST controller class for managing desktop sessions, exposing CRUD endpoints.

methods.name: listSessions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all desktop sessions.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Retrieves a specific desktop session by ID via GET request.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new desktop session via POST request.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates an existing desktop session's information via PUT request.

methods.name: deleteSession
methods.description: Deletes a desktop session by ID via DELETE request.
